advancements.cortescombat.arcabuz: A bamboo, a firer, a dispenser and some wood. The Firestone is the expensive part.
advancements.cortescombat.familia.alabar: Spear, hook and edge on one pole: it sweeps whatever the arc holds.
advancements.cortescombat.familia.daga: Swift above everything, and the only one with a wooden grip.
advancements.cortescombat.familia.martil: Against armour there is no subtlety, only weight. Consecutive hits stack.
advancements.cortescombat.familia.ropera: Fine steel that learned to strike at a distance: reach above all.
advancements.cortescombat.familia.shotel: The curved blade of the sabre: it parries, and a charge lands two cuts.
enchantment.cortescombat.adrenalina.desc: Taking a hit hurts 25% less (35% at level 2) and speeds you up for 5 s; level 2 adds the saving to your next hit.
enchantment.cortescombat.apunalar.desc: Hitting from behind, more than 90 degrees off: +60% damage, or +90% at level 2.
enchantment.cortescombat.astilladora.des: Blocking this edge costs two stamina instead of one.
enchantment.cortescombat.audacity.desc: The lunge's cooldown is 20% cheaper per level.
enchantment.cortescombat.aventurero.desc: The mobs you kill drop 20% more experience per level.
enchantment.cortescombat.barredor.desc: The halberd's sweep reaches and spreads 15% wider (30% at level 2).
enchantment.cortescombat.capacitor.desc: A parried projectile returns as lightning: 3 damage (4 at level 2) plus the weapon's, and burns for 4 s.
enchantment.cortescombat.cicatrizador.de: The hit leaves anti-healing: -15% per level to any healing, for 5 s.
enchantment.cortescombat.corte_gemelo.de: A normal hit cuts again for 50%: every 4 s at level 1, always at level 2.
enchantment.cortescombat.culata.desc: The arcabuz bayonet shoves 25%, 50% or 75% harder by level.
The charged hit leaves bleeding: 1 heart every 2 s for 6 s (10 s at level 2).
enchantment.cortescombat.desvio_vampiric: Each parry steals 1 heart of max health, up to the level in hearts, for 10 s.
enchantment.cortescombat.dry_powder.desc: Reloading the arcabuz takes 50, 40 or 30 ticks by level.
enchantment.cortescombat.ensarte.desc: The thrust pierces: 50% of the damage (100% at level 2) to one body lined up behind.
enchantment.cortescombat.estocada.desc: The lunge's hit ignores 15% of armour (30% at level 2).
The weapon feels light: +0.1 attack speed per level, up to +0.3.
Each piece of the target's armour adds 6% damage (10% at level 2), up to four.
enchantment.cortescombat.gold_echo.desc: Your hit marks it and makes it glow: it takes 20% more damage from everything.
enchantment.cortescombat.golden_hands.de: What the shovel breaks goes straight into your inventory, not the ground.
The hoe replants what it harvests; at level 2 the crop also drops twice.
enchantment.cortescombat.gripa.desc: Hits leave muck: 1 damage per stack every 20 ticks (15 at level 2), up to 4 stacks (6).
enchantment.cortescombat.guardia_firme.d: The first block of every 3 seconds costs no stamina.
enchantment.cortescombat.inercia.desc: The hammer's streak push goes upwards: +10% vertical per level and nothing horizontal.
enchantment.cortescombat.life_steal.desc: 5% of the damage you deal per level comes back to you as health.
enchantment.cortescombat.mecha_corta.des: The arcabuz fuse burns for 20, 15 or 10 ticks by level.
enchantment.cortescombat.mella.desc: Enemy armour wears x1.5, x2, x2.5 or x3 faster; the charged axe already doubles the wear.
enchantment.cortescombat.midas_tool.desc: Ores you mine may come out as gold: 25, 50 or 75%, plus a nugget at level 3.
enchantment.cortescombat.midas_touch.des: Kills leave gold nuggets; higher levels add ingots and even golden apples.
enchantment.cortescombat.miner_frenzy.de: Each block broken speeds up the next: +8%, up to five per level; stop and it is gone.
enchantment.cortescombat.mungus.desc: Ten Firestones load one shot that opens the ground into a crater.
enchantment.cortescombat.pala_antimateri: The charged right click throws an orb that pulls in and blows up whatever is near.
enchantment.cortescombat.paliza.desc: The charged hit that closes a streak shoves 2.4 blocks and lifts 0.6; level 2 needs a shorter streak.
enchantment.cortescombat.phantom_block.d: One block in ten gives up its drops twice.
A 15% per level chance the blow ignores armour completely.
enchantment.cortescombat.punta_fina.desc: At 1.5 blocks or closer: +15% damage, or +25% at level 2.
enchantment.cortescombat.quebranto.desc: Each hit strips 8% of their armour, up to three times; hitting again refreshes it.
enchantment.cortescombat.retirada.desc: While sneaking, the lunge goes backwards and the forward hit lands on the press.
enchantment.cortescombat.rey_de_las_mosc: The shot leaves flies on every body in the cone: 4 damage every 10 ticks, for 4 s.
The hammer's streak holds longer: 80, 100 or 120 ticks by level.
enchantment.cortescombat.riposte.desc: After a real block, your next hit ignores 25% of armour (50% at level 2).
enchantment.cortescombat.sanguijuela.des: 8% of the hit's damage (14% at level 2) returns to you as health.
enchantment.cortescombat.santa_muerte.de: Killing leaves a rotten cloud: wither for 5 s in a radius of 3.
A sweep that killed nobody refunds 30% of its cooldown (50% at level 2).
enchantment.cortescombat.segundo_aliento: Break your guard and your next hit within 3 s deals +15% (+25% at level 2) and shoves +50%.
enchantment.cortescombat.sentencia.desc: On the fifth streak hit the body bursts: 8 damage (12 at level 2) and 4 to everything within 2.5 blocks.
enchantment.cortescombat.steel_reflex.de: Parry comes back a second sooner per level: 100, 80 and 60 ticks.
enchantment.cortescombat.trabazon.desc: The charged hit keeps it from jumping; level 2 also from sprinting. It lasts 1.5 s.
enchantment.cortescombat.wind_walker.des: While held, +5% walking speed per level, up to +25%.
tooltip.cortescombat.mechanic.arcabuz: Spends a Firestone from the inventory: right click reloads, left click fires
tooltip.cortescombat.mechanic.halberd: Right click: sweeps the whole arc, and costs the same cooldown as a hit
tooltip.cortescombat.mechanic.mace: The damage is the fall: up to %s, falling %s blocks. Landing a hit cancels the fall
tooltip.cortescombat.mechanic.ropera: Right click: forward lunge, and it passes through several
tooltip.cortescombat.mechanic.sabre: Right click: parry. A %s s window, a %s s cooldown
tooltip.cortescombat.mechanic.trident: Right click throws it; charged, it pulls the target in
tooltip.cortescombat.mechanic.warhammer: Escalates with each consecutive hit; the streak lasts %s s
tooltip.cortescombat.special.fusee: Right Click: spends a Firestone, and a second later burns the whole cone
tooltip.cortescombat.special.multi_hit: Right Click: hits everything in the cone
tooltip.cortescombat.special.parry: Right Click: parry, returns the hit you take
